name: com.tkscmlimited.mine/hawaii-data
title: The Mine by tkscm — Hawaiʻi economic data
description: Hawaiʻi economic statistics from U.S. and other public agencies, with sources and notices. Free.

tools.name: latest
tools.description: The newest stored value of one series: value as published, period, unit, coverage line, source, the source's notice, retrieval date, and flags when the series is late (stale), late at the agency itself, entered by hand, or its source is paused. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

series_id.description: A series id from search_series or /v1/series, e.g. hi.unemp.rate.sa.m

tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Find series by words in their id, title or coverage (all words must match; case and the ʻokina are ignored). Optional exact filters: geo, source, frequency. Returns up to 50 series a page (id, title, unit, frequency, geo, coverage, source). Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "unemployment rate Kauai"

geo.description: Geography code, e.g. HI, HI.HON, HI.HAW, HI.MAU, HI.KAU, HI.KAL, US

source.description: Source id from list_sources, e.g. BLS, BTS, CENSUSTRADE

frequency.description: D daily, W weekly, M monthly, Q quarterly, A annual

page.description: Page number (50 series a page); default 1

tools.name: series_history
tools.description: Up to 12 most recent values of one series, newest first, one per period (the current version; a revised value is marked). Longer histories and as-of views are not part of the free door (Terms §7B). Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

series_id.description: A series id from search_series or /v1/series, e.g. hi.unemp.rate.sa.m

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Every source agency: name, homepage, terms URL, required notice, and status (live, paused, hand entry, or not collected), with any series the agency itself is late with. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

tools.name: weekly_pulse
tools.description: The Weekly Pulse for one week, as JSON: what changed at The Mine (new periods, agencies' revisions, first values, values entered by hand, late and paused sources, the next checks), in fixed sentences built only from stored figures; no model writes it. Default: the latest issue. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

date.description: The issue's Monday, YYYY-MM-DD (Honolulu time); default the latest

tools.name: how_to_buy
tools.description: How The Packet Line (The Mine's paid monthly issues for organizations) is bought: whether plans are on sale, how payment is completed, and what an order placed by software must include. No input. Prices: /pricing.json. Facts, not investment or other advice.

tools.name: notices
tools.description: SAM.gov contract notices posted by offices in Hawaiʻi whose response deadline has not passed, from SAM.gov's public Opportunities API: title, notice type, agency path, NAICS code, set-aside, response deadline, place of performance as published, and the notice's public SAM.gov link (contacts, descriptions and attachments are only there). Listed in Hawaiʻi first (The Mine's own classification of the place of performance), then performed elsewhere. Award notices and justifications are not listed. Each notice and the list carry retrieved_at. Deadlines and details change. Confirm on SAM.gov before you rely on them. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.
